Singapore, Singapore203 contributions

Good choice for a street food dinner
Sep 2015 • Couples
This road-side stall only opens in the evening from about 5.30pm. The seating area is set up outside a toy shop after it closes.

A small menu but each dish is executed well:

Roast pigeon - expertly seasoned, juicy, crisp skin. 
Bit tet - Vietnamese-style steak in a flavourful brown sauce, served with chips and baguette
Fried rice noodle with beef and vegetable - tasty brown sauce means you will finish everything.

We paid about 230k dong for two people including drinks.
